title: Upgrade
subtitle: What this deployment is running, and how far back it can be taken.
error: Could not read the upgrade status.

buildKindHint.development: Built straight to this server, bypassing the release pipeline.
buildKindHint.unknown: No build markers, so this core was started outside a container.

rollback.heading: Going back
rollback.unrestricted: Every migration here is reversible, so an earlier release still runs — and nothing is deleted by going back.
rollback.floored: This database can only be run by Yagra {{minCore}} or newer.
rollback.flooredHint: Anything older needs a restore from backup.

mechanism.heading: Upgrading from here
mechanism.switchHint: Upgrades are carried out by a separate container holding the Docker socket. Off means none can be requested and it stops contacting the registry. Stored in the database, so it survives upgrades.
mechanism.switchPending: Saved. The updater applies it within a few seconds.
mechanism.switchFailed: The setting could not be saved.
mechanism.paused: Upgrading from the WebUI is switched off.
mechanism.unsupported: This deployment cannot be upgraded from here.
mechanism.unsupportedHint: Upgrading from the WebUI needs a container deployment that runs the updater alongside Yagra, and this one was not installed that way. Nothing is wrong — upgrade it the way it was installed, from the command line. Everything above stays accurate either way.
mechanism.disabled: No updater has reported on this deployment.
mechanism.disabledHint: It ships with the deployment, so the stack has not finished starting or the service was removed.
mechanism.stopped: The updater is enabled but has stopped reporting.
mechanism.stoppedHint: It ran at some point, so this is a fault rather than a setting:
mechanism.readyFrom: Releases come from {{repo}}, fixed by this server.
mechanism.neverChecked: The release list has not been fetched yet.
mechanism.checkFailed: Could not ask the updater to check.
mechanism.checkTimeout: The updater did not answer. Check that it is running.
mechanism.noNewer: No release newer than the one running.
mechanism.noRegistry: The updater could not reach a registry. Expected on a closed network.

bundle.heading: Install from a file
bundle.intro: For a site with no registry. Save the release's images elsewhere and bring the file here; the rest of the upgrade is identical.
bundle.howTo: docker save -o yagra-v0.2.2.tar ghcr.io/horryworks/yagra-core:v0.2.2 ghcr.io/horryworks/yagra-poller:v0.2.2 ghcr.io/horryworks/yagra-web:v0.2.2
bundle.needTag: Enter the release this file contains, for example v0.2.2.
bundle.limit: Up to {{size}} GiB, plus about twice that again in free space to unpack it.
bundle.failed: The archive could not be uploaded.

offerBlock.below_floor: This version cannot read the current database.
offerBlock.unknown: Cannot tell whether this version can read the current database.
offerBlock.pollers_behind: This jump would leave a poller more than one release behind, which the bus does not support. Upgrade to the release in between first.

pollers.heading: Pollers
pollers.withCore: {{count}} poller is replaced by this operation.
pollers.withCore_other: {{count}} pollers are replaced by this operation.
pollers.manual: {{count}} poller stays on its current version:
pollers.manual_other: {{count}} pollers stay on their current version:
pollers.manualHint: A remote-site poller upgrades itself only when a site updater is deployed beside it. Until then, upgrade it on its own host.
pollers.darkPools: {{count}} pool has only one poller, so monitoring stops there while its container is recreated: {{pools}}
pollers.darkPools_other: {{count}} pools have only one poller, so monitoring stops there while their containers are recreated: {{pools}}

align.heading: Pollers on a different build
align.hint: Nothing in this deployment restarts. Each pool is brought across one poller at a time, so a pool with more than one keeps monitoring throughout. A poller ahead of this core is moved back to it.
align.started: Started. Each site pulls the image first and is recreated only once it has it, so this list can take several minutes to shrink.
align.failed: Could not start the poller upgrade.

pollers.confirmSplit: {{withCore}} poller upgrades with this deployment; {{count}} does not and stays on its current version: {{names}}
pollers.confirmSplit_other: {{withCore}} pollers upgrade with this deployment; {{count}} do not and stay on their current version: {{names}}

confirmBody.upgrade: Every Yagra container is replaced with {{tag}}. Monitoring stops and this page loses its connection until the new version is up.
confirmBody.rollback: Every Yagra container is replaced with {{tag}}, which is older. Nothing is deleted, but anything only the newer version understood stops being visible until you come forward again. Monitoring stops and this page loses its connection.

apply.confirmBackup: A backup is taken first. It lands on this host, so it is a rollback aid, not disaster recovery.
apply.confirmFloor: This database cannot be taken back past {{minCore}}.
apply.failed: The upgrade could not be started.

run.heading: Last run
run.starting: Handed to the updater; waiting for it to start
run.disconnectWarning: This page will lose its connection and come back on its own. Do not reload or restart anything.
run.reconnecting: Connection lost — this is the containers being replaced. Waiting for the new version.
